title: ContainerChat
description: This plugin adds the ability to simply do [c] in chat whilst facing a chest or container, to display the contents of the container to everyone in chat.
body:
This plugin adds the ability for players to simply do [c] or [container] in chat whilst facing and pointing towards a chest or container, to display the contents of the container to everyone in chat.

DEPENDENCIES

ContainerChat-1.0.2 - Java 17+

All other versions - Java 21+


Other players in chat can view the container by simply hovering over 'Looking over _**chest**_' when a player does [c]. 

Permissions
Defautlt-containerchat.use
Admin-containerchat.reload
